note:
R132 - League 1.4 / Teams 2.4 "different dimensions" on the older package forms (developer ledger: "RW4-in-BIGF: whether the loose RW4
descriptor rule + the Apt quad rewrite apply inside the 07-11 package form is unmeasured"). Read-only over the Xbox 360 loose trees.
Per logo package `fe/ion/artassets/<family>/*.big` (families: team logos, small / wide / dynasty / calendar, league logos, small / wide):
  wrapper    : whole-file RefPack (NHL 08-10 per receipt 13) or plain BIGF; unwrapped with the 2026-09-21 speech-model decoder;
  members    : BIGF directory (names, sizes); texture member = the member whose bytes are RW4 (`\x89RW4`) or XPR2 (largest if several);
  texture    : RW4xb2 - file-table chunk types, raster count, the primary raster's (w, h, format) decoded as R107 documents; XPR2 - w, h;
  Apt rule   : Studio's 12 -> Legacy dimension rule (assets.rs rewrite_apt_geometry): member `<n+1>` of 288 bytes whose six vertices at +96
               (stride 32) are (0,H) (0,0) (W,0) (W,0) (W,H) (0,H) for the texture's (W, H), and member `0` = "Apt Data:" whose object table
               (16 + u32@16) carries W, H as u32 at +20 and as f32 at +96.
Classes per package: full-texture quad (rule holds) / display-crop quad (record present, vertices differ) / layout absent / not a logo package.
NHL 12 (XPR2 packages) is run as the control where Studio already resizes. Nothing is written; no member is re-encoded.
Usage: python r132_old_logo_package_resize_inputs.py <out.json>
